COURSE: ITLG201 – Reading Skills
DOCUMENT: Task Instruction: Reading-based Discussion 1
To be held in class during Week 4 [Tuesday (June 23rd, 2025)]
Students are required to take part in a reading-based discussion within a small group. Each group will be
presented with a short article from an English language source, which they will have 10 minutes to read and
prepare notes. Students will then be invited to take part in a discussion-based environment on a series of
discussion questions formulated by their group members.
The instructor will be responsible for creating student groupings and assignment topics.
Learning Objectives:
1. Reinforce Reading Skills required to survey a text, form and anticipate questions, and recall information.
2. Demonstrate the ability to summarize information from an external source, and use details to form and
support a Personal Response (Opinion) which will be presented orally.
3. Further develop English communication skills by providing their views on provided information, and
responding to ideas presented by others:
a. Demonstrate a clear connection between what is presented in the source article and interpreted ideas
being communicated.
b. Encourage the use of language used to present an opinion, and to support it through reasoning.
c. Enhance communicative skills through observing classmates giving their opinions, and developing their
own abilities when speaking; improving their ability to react to information and respond to the ideas and
opinions of others.
d. Encourage the development of Active Listening Skills and increase confidence when speaking in a group.
Requirements:
To earn credit for this assignment, each student will be required to:
1. Take 10 minutes to read and summarize the main points of a short article from an English-language
newspaper, magazine, or website.
2. Take part in a discussion of the provided article, lasting up to 10 minutes.
3. Attempt to provide his/her views of the article topic and respond to discussion questions and prompts from
other students.
4. Use appropriate language when expressing a view on a topic, or responding to other students.
5. Use relevant information from the article to support and provide clear reasoning for points being made.
6. Demonstrate Summarizing and Paraphrasing skills to integrate information from the original article, without
restating ideas word-for-word as they appeared in the text.
7. Demonstrate active listening skills by responding to the ideas of other students: Follow-up questions or
Interjections
Note: All students are required to take part in the discussion. Not sharing views will result in a very low score.
